days.title: Historic sites
days.morning: Con Dao prison, Phu Hai camp and the tiger cages.
days.evening: Visit Hang Duong cemetery and the grave of Vo Thi Sau (around 11 pm – midnight).

days.title: Unspoilt islands
days.morning: Swim at Dam Trau beach – watch planes land right overhead.
days.afternoon: Snorkel the coral reefs at Bay Canh (or Cau) island.
days.evening: Seafood at Con Dao night market.

days.title: Primeval forest
days.morning: Trek the Ong Dung trail to a wild beach.
days.afternoon: Lady Phi Yen temple and Van Son pagoda.
days.evening: Stroll Con Son town and its seafront cafés.

days.title: Bay Canh – sea turtles
days.morning: Speedboat to Bay Canh island and its turtle conservation station.
days.afternoon: Swim and snorkel at Dam Tre beach.
days.evening: Watch turtles nesting (May – September, registration required).

days.title: Shark cape – Nhat beach
days.morning: Sunrise at Shark cape and Nhat beach at low tide.
days.afternoon: Swim at An Hai beach and buy tropical almonds as gifts.
